auth_methods.quote: Every API request must include your API key in the x-api-key header.
auth_methods.note: Docs live at commasdocs.com (FanBasis rebranded to Commas; fanbasis.com redirects to commas.com). Docs host is not in apps.json official_domains but the docs reference fanbasis.com endpoints and support@fanbasis.com.

credential_access.quote: you can start building right away using a sandbox API key from the sandbox dashboard
credential_access.note: Sandbox key is self-serve; production key requires account identity verification (not a paid plan).

production_gate.quote: Once your account is verified, switch to your live API key to go live.
production_gate.note: Account verification only; no app review or partner program documented.

api_type.quote: Every endpoint is served under the /public-api/ path on https://www.fanbasis.com
api_type.note: REST over x-api-key; also a checkout JS/React SDK and a CLI documented as tooling.

mcp_official.quote: MCP beta Run Commas from your AI assistant.
mcp_official.note: Official site advertises MCP (beta); docs describe a Commas MCP Connector with 44 tools (some client setups marked Coming Soon).

main_blocker_type.quote: Do I need to wait for account verification before I can start integrating? No
main_blocker_type.note: Self-serve sandbox and docs; only caveat is non-obvious docs host after rebrand.
